title: Executive director.
bodyText: The commission shall appoint an executive director for the proper administration and enforcement of this chapter without regard to chapter 76.
bodyHtml: §367-2.5  Executive director.  The commission shall appoint an executive director for the proper administration and enforcement of this chapter without regard to chapter 76. [L 1984, c 74, §1; am L 1995, c 151, §4; am L 2000, c 253, §150]
